title: Bible kralicka (Kralice Bible), full Old and New Testament, one verse per line
period: 1579-1613 (Unity of the Brethren translation; spelling as in the 1613 edition's modern-orthography reprints)
notes: Translation published 1579-1594, revised 1613; public domain by age. Redistributed in scrollmapper/bible_databases (MIT repository). Orthography is modernized (e.g. 'Bůh', 'stvořil'), which the pinned normalization folds to a-z anyway. refcorpus.normalize(..., 'czech') gives 3,363,852 characters; English book headings (66 words) are negligible. Early-modern rather than Old Czech: closer to 1400-1450 than the 19th-century text now pinned, and enough text for the controls. A period Old Czech text (e.g. the Dresden/Olomouc Bible) is still wanted.
